_help.generate_alert: false = event is only stored/logged (e.g. traffic sound)
_help.top2_margin: minimum gap between best and second-best class
_help.required_consecutive: detections needed in consecutive segments / live windows (within repeat_window_seconds)
_help.strong_confidence: if BOTH models agree at or above this confidence, one detection is enough (0 = never)
_help.require_model_agreement: Python and GTM must predict the same class
_help.min_quality: worst audio quality accepted for an automatic alert: Good | Acceptable | Poor
_help.manual_review_if_unconfirmed: send to the review queue when the event is detected but not confirmed
_help.escalate_after_repeats / escalate_to: raise severity when the event keeps repeating
_help.audience: roles that see and handle the alert (admin always sees everything)

Machinery Fault.recommended_action: Maintenance alert: stop or isolate the machine if safe and schedule an inspection.

Glass Breaking.recommended_action: Security alert: check the location / CCTV for break-in or vandalism.

Alarm or Siren.recommended_action: Attention: verify the alarm source and follow the site emergency procedure.

Vehicle Horn.recommended_action: Traffic / environmental sound logged. No action unless it persists.

Animal Sound.recommended_action: Non-critical event logged. Check context if animals are not expected here.

Gunshot.recommended_action: CRITICAL: possible gunshot. Alert security immediately, keep people away, contact emergency services per site policy.

Panic Scream.recommended_action: CRITICAL safety alert: send staff to the location and check for injury or danger.

Aggression.recommended_action: Security alert: possible aggression / violent conflict. Dispatch a security officer.

Person Asking for Help.recommended_action: CRITICAL: a person is calling for help. Respond to the location immediately.

Background Noise.noise_alert_action: Background noise is above the configured limit – check the environment / microphone placement.

Unknown.recommended_action: Sound could not be classified reliably – manual review required.
